title: Stack Overflow year-over-year change minus comparison-site year-over-year change

annotations.label: GitHub Copilot generally available to all developers
Stack Overflow moderators begin a strike over AI-content policy

notes: Alternative view to the relative-activity index. Stack Overflow's year-over-year percent change in monthly new questions minus the mean year-over-year percent change across the primary comparison sites (each site first, then the mean). Computed from so_questions_monthly and se_comparison_questions_monthly. The series starts 2012-07, the first month in which all four primary sites have a year-over-year change, so the comparison mean covers the same four sites throughout. AI also affects the comparison sites, so this shows Stack Overflow relative to them, not the absolute AI effect.
